changes.summary: Each party's liability cap falls from twelve months of customer fees to three months.
changes.before: 9.2 Each party's total liability under these Terms will not exceed the fees paid by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
changes.after: 9.2 Each party's total liability under these Terms will not exceed the fees paid by Customer in the three (3) months preceding the claim.
changes.vendor_claim: Vendor says: "These updates do not materially change your rights."
changes.so_what: Review with counsel before December 15 whether the reduced mutual cap changes recovery exposure or requires negotiated protection.

changes.summary: Training prohibition becomes permission for de-identified data; new 4.4 offers an opt-out covering only data received after confirmation.
changes.before: 4.3 Ledgerline will not use Customer Data to train machine learning models.
changes.after:
4.3 Ledgerline may use Customer Data in de-identified form to train and improve machine learning models, unless Customer opts out under Section 4.4.
4.4 Customer may opt out of the use described in Section 4.3 by emailing privacy@ledgerline.example. The opt-out applies to Customer Data received after Ledgerline confirms it.
changes.vendor_claim: Vendor says: "We've updated our Terms to clarify how we improve our services. These updates do not materially change your rights."
changes.so_what: Review with counsel before December 15 whether to opt out, obtain confirmation, and seek protection for data received before confirmation.

noise_ignored: Fees and Taxes swapped section numbers 7 and 8; their wording is unchanged.

assumptions: Used the scheduled trigger date, November 16, 2026, as the check date; no previous check was supplied, so the window starts seven days earlier.

The archive's actual capture is November 7, not the requested November 9; it precedes the window start and is within the 21-day baseline age limit.

report_markdown:
**Terms changes** 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-16
Ledgerline reduces the mutual liability cap and replaces its AI-training prohibition with permission subject to a prospective opt-out.

- **Ledgerline terms, 9.2 Limitation of Liability: cap reduced** ([live](https://ledgerline.example/legal/terms), [before](https://web.archive.org/web/20261107153012/https://ledgerline.example/legal/terms))
  Before: "in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim." · After: "in the three (3) months preceding the claim."
  Version November 12, 2026 · Effective December 15, 2026.
  _Review recovery exposure and negotiated protection with counsel._

- **Ledgerline terms, 4.3 Customer Data, with added 4.4: AI training permitted unless opted out** ([live](https://ledgerline.example/legal/terms), [before](https://web.archive.org/web/20261107153012/https://ledgerline.example/legal/terms))
  Before: "4.3 Ledgerline will not use Customer Data to train machine learning models." · After: "4.3 Ledgerline may use Customer Data in de-identified form to train and improve machine learning models, unless Customer opts out under Section 4.4."
  Added 4.4 limits the opt-out: "The opt-out applies to Customer Data received after Ledgerline confirms it."
  Version November 12, 2026 · Effective December 15, 2026. Vendor says: "These updates do not materially change your rights."
  _Review opting out, confirmation timing and treatment of previously received data with counsel._

_Baseline: November 7 archive capture. Support typo and Fees/Taxes renumbering ignored. Unchanged pages: none; no-baseline pages: none; unreachable supplied texts: none._
_Not legal advice: review each change with counsel._
